name: Gemma-Kimu-9b-it
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from google/gemma-2-9b (config.json max_position_embeddings 8192). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-31. Basque continual pre-training of google/gemma-2-9b (521M words ZelaiHandi + ~300M tokens FineWeb English replay) followed by a DELTA MERGE of the gemma-2-9b-it post-training delta - hence derivative_kind merge, not finetune; same Gemma-2 9B config, 9.24B. Card prints the pair in one NoRobotsEU table: Basque instruction-following 71 vs 57, but English DROPS 82 vs 86. Known attribution wrinkle: the card's base_model tag is the PRE-TRAINED google/gemma-2-9b while the comparison column is the INSTRUCT gemma-2-9b-it; the record is based on gemma-2-9b (as tagged) and the row config says so. Licence gemma. Repo created 2025-10-06.
